positions.name: ErasureDirectiveAuthority
positions.frame: On what basis does the speaker claim standing to command what the organization must forget or stop knowing?
positions.why: Both segments perform the same act — a bare imperative to erase knowledge, first of a named artifact (the fleet and its contracts) then generalized to a whole category (routes) — with no rationale or consultation offered. The directional reads converge tightly: relational and power both mint the same authority-ranking / coercive-pressure pattern across exactly these two segments, conviction reads both as decision-grade (settled instruction, not argument), and temporal reads both as present-tense irrealis pushing toward a not-yet-actual state. The pair coheres as one directional read of a single command escalating from a specific object to a categorical one; no tension to resolve, just widening scope of the same claimed authority.
